purpose_context: Doctrine's internals are currently reached through many scattered back-doors, which blocks packaging it as the installable wheel the roadmap depends on. This mission defines one curated public surface, routes every consumer through the sanctioned charter facades, and adds an automated guard so the boundary cannot silently erode — the precondition for the planned kernel to doctrine to charter wheel cutover.
purpose_tldr: Give the doctrine module a stable, enforced public API so it can ship as a standalone package.
